next.reason: 1985: 'There are five categories of data that can be described with a PICTURE clause: alphabetic, numeric, alphanumeric, alphanumeric edited, and numeric edited.' §2023:13.18.40.4 GR3 lists eight: the five plus boolean, national and national-edited, so PICTURE strings of '1' or 'N' (not 1985 symbols, refused) now define items. Its BWZ sentence was already 1985 law (VI.5.4.4 GR2).
